contract: Open the sole-program TS188 or M2TS192 entity through AnyReader. Exercise reset and Blocking::seek, which routes the request through AnyReader::request_seek.

Compare the requested, landing and discard times and every selected picture packet through EOF with the unchanged MPEG-TS picture seek reference. Fold source presentation time, effective decode time, neutral random access and payload. Repeated cases seek again after EOF.

The transport report covers the sole-program single-entity cases. Explicit transport epochs and split entities require format-specific APIs. Matroska and ISO BMFF compare native seek receipts and packet suffixes with container-pins.json. For ISO BMFF, choose the prior sync sample on the unedited presentation timeline in a complete reference packet scan, then seek by its decode timestamp with the native backward seek.
